newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea intervenes to buy dlrs again.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea intervenes to buy dlrs again.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) intervened again in the local currency market on Wednesday afternoon, purchasing about $50 million at 899.50 won and another $50 million at 900 won in six-month forward trading, dealers said.
The bank has never confirmed its intervention.
The won weakened to 888.90 to the dollar in the spot market against 888.40 before the intervention, dealers said.
Earlier in the afternoon, the central bank intervened in one-year forward trading, buying about $20 million dollars, dealers said.
They said the central bank came in to prevent a further rise in the local currency against the dollar.
